props.gloss_en: one does not recite the opening of Shema [poresin al Shema] with fewer than ten
one does not pass before the ark with fewer than ten
the priests do not lift their hands with fewer than ten
one does not read in the Torah with fewer than ten
one does not conclude with the Prophets with fewer than ten
one does not perform the standing and sitting [for the dead] with fewer than ten
one does not say the mourners' blessing with fewer than ten
nor the comforting of mourners with fewer than ten
nor the grooms' blessing with fewer than ten
one does not invite to grace with the Name with fewer than ten
the mishnah's list as a whole: none of these is done with fewer than ten (the הני מילי whose source 23b.6 asks for)
and [the assessment of consecrated] land: nine and a priest
and [the assessment of] a person likewise
as the verse says: 'and I shall be sanctified among the children of Israel' (Lev 22:32)
any matter of sanctity shall not be [done] with fewer than ten
